title: Piano Concerto No.3
subtitle: (op.7 2026)
description:
这首第三钢协规模宏大，变化多端，沉重而复杂。动机在挣扎中发展，旋律在不断递进。全曲不分乐章，连续演奏。
参考了肖斯塔科维奇第五交响曲。
It is a large-scale, complex, and heavy work. The motifs develop in struggle, and the melodies progress continuously. The entire piece is performed without breaks between movements.
Inspired by Shostakovich's Symphony No. 5.

title: Piano Impromptu No.1
subtitle: (op.18 2026)
description:
第一首纯即兴曲。没有谱子，随心而弹。总体分为三个乐章，也可以看作无乐章分割。这下没有人说我不会弹钢琴了。
This is my first purely improvised piece. There is no sheet music; I simply played from the heart. Overall, it is structured into three movements, though it could also be viewed as a continuous piece without distinct breaks. Now, no one can say I don't know how to play the piano.

title: Piano Trio No.1 —— For Cello, Contracello and Piano
subtitle: (op.15 2026)
description:
一首钢琴三重奏小品。钢琴，大提琴，低音提琴沉重的声音昭示着一个伟大的终章。
A piano trio piece. The heavy sounds of the piano, cello, and double bass herald a grand finale.

title: Symphony No.1 "A Voyage"
subtitle: (op.4 2025)
description:
充满个性与张力的第一交响曲。波澜壮阔的大海，激昂的风暴，宁静的港湾，交织成一段奇妙的旅程。
A symphony full of personality and tension. The vast sea, the raging storm

title: Sonata for 2 Pianos
subtitle: (op.14 2026)
description:
一首为两架钢琴而作的奏鸣曲。两架钢琴在对话中交织，旋律在空间中回荡，形成一种独特的音乐体验。
A sonata for two pianos. The two pianos intertwine in dialogue, with melodies echoing in space, creating a unique musical experience.
